heading: Cover letter — junior SRE / DevOps
body:
I am a Cape Town-based production engineer with eight years of PHP and Linux, looking for a junior-to-mid globally remote SRE or DevOps role with flexible hours.

At Silicon Overdrive I own production PHP/Laravel systems on Linux: deploys, MySQL tuning on live databases, and incident follow-through — not only feature tickets. I run Docker and AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS) for client workloads, and I earned AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional while in this role. Earlier at RogerWilco I shipped LAMP applications on Ubuntu and small AWS hosts, including deployments, testing, and production issue resolution.

I am honest about the shape of that experience. PHP/Laravel is paid production work, not the headline I want next. I am building public evidence toward SRE: Terraform and CodePipeline on a live fleet stack, CustomCodeScanner quality gates, and a Kubernetes k3s/k3d lab that is in progress. I do not claim years of production Kubernetes.

I want a team where 24/7 ownership is not 24/7 firefighting: SLOs, automation, and runbooks. I work SAST (UTC+2) and prefer flexible hours while I finish a BSc in Information Technology alongside a full working week.

Thank you for your time. I would welcome a conversation.
